Thai Solitude plans to begin massage sessions in November. Questions are welcome now—get in touch with Butsaba. Meet Butsaba Dusrai Discover the Heart of Thai Solitude Butsaba Dusrai is an Oregon Licensed Massage Therapist with hands-on experience since 2020.I trained in massage therapy at Estelle Medical Academy and in traditional Thai bodywork at Still Light Center. My work includes Thai, therapeutic, and relaxation massage. I begin by listening to your goals, then adapt the pressure, pace, and focus to your comfort. Learn About Thai SolitudeThai Solitude is my independent practice, shaped by traditional Thai bodywork and a personal approach to therapeutic massage. Each session starts with a conversation and stays responsive to how you feel. My Commitment to Your WellnessMy aim is to create a calm, professional space where you can share your goals and feel comfortable speaking up. I tailor the pace, pressure, and focus of each session to you. Massage as Part of Everyday CareI want massage to feel approachable, whether you come in with a specific area of tension or simply need time to slow down. Values That Guide Every SessionTrust, professionalism, and empathy shape my work. I listen to your goals, check in about comfort, and make room for your feedback throughout the session. The Journey of Thai SolitudeI founded Thai Solitude in 2024 after beginning my massage work in 2020. Alongside running the practice, I have worked in a Thai bodywork studio and a busy massage setting. I look forward to welcoming Portland clients when sessions begin in November. Thai Solitude plans to begin massage sessions in November. Questions are welcome now—get in touch with Butsaba. Explore Butsaba’s Professional Massage Services Therapeutic MassageTherapeutic massage uses focused pressure and a pace adapted to your comfort. Tell Butsaba where you feel tension and what you would like from the session; she can adjust the work as you go. Deep Tissue MassageDeep tissue massage uses focused, deliberate pressure for areas of persistent tightness. Butsaba checks in about pressure and adapts the work to your comfort. Thai MassageTraditional Thai massage blends gentle rocking, rhythmic compression, and assisted stretching to help ease stiffness and encourage comfortable movement. Butsaba adapts the pressure, pace, and range of each stretch to your needs, creating a session that can feel restful or more active. Ideal when you want bodywork that combines relaxation with guided movement. SpecializedYour session begins with a conversation about what you would like from your time with Butsaba—focused work, deep relaxation, or a little of both. Together, you choose the pace, pressure, and techniques that feel right for you. The result is thoughtful, personal bodywork shaped around your comfort and goals. Our Step-by-Step Massage Process Explained Consultation and AssessmentThai Solitude begins with a thorough consultation to understand your needs, preferences, and any specific concerns regarding discomfort, tension, or restricted movement. Customized Treatment PlanButsaba uses your goals and preferences to choose a comfortable pace, pressure, and focus for the session. Execution of Massage TechniquesButsaba applies specific massage techniques according to your treatment plan, focusing on areas that require the most attention and care, including muscle knots. Post-Treatment Care and Follow-UpAfter your session, Butsaba can discuss how the work felt and whether a follow-up session would be useful. Thai Solitude plans to begin massage sessions in November. Questions are welcome now—get in touch with Butsaba. Work With Me · Portland-area opportunities Butsaba Dusrai Oregon licensed massage therapist Butsaba brings traditional Thai bodywork, therapeutic and relaxation massage, and a listening ear to each session. She is interested in joining a Portland-area practice that values thoughtful, individual care. Massage experience since 2020 · Native Thai and fluent English Contact Butsaba View Résumé For practice owners · Credentials · For clients The person behind the work A career shaped by people and practice. Before massage, Butsaba worked in export sales and customer service for Thai manufacturers. That experience informs the way she listens, communicates clearly, and follows through with clients. Since 2020, she has worked in a Thai bodywork studio, a busy Chicago massage setting, and a practice of her own. At Windy City Massage, her clients included hotel guests and business travelers. When the time together may be a single visit, the opening conversation matters. Her approach Listen. Assess. Adapt. Butsaba begins with what brought someone in, then lets their comfort and feedback guide the work. 01Listen firstA conversation about goals, preferences, relevant history, and what would make the session useful. 02Notice and respondObserve comfort and areas of tension within massage scope, then invite feedback during the work. 03Make it individualAdjust pressure, pacing, focus, and movement instead of following the same routine for everyone. For practice owners & hiring teams Range and care for your team. Hands-on rangeTraditional Thai massage, guided movement and assisted stretching, therapeutic bodywork, and relaxation massage. Sessions respond to each client’s goals and comfort. Client care and operationsButsaba founded Thai Solitude and handles consultations, scheduling, client communication, and day-to-day operations. She brings that service experience into a shared practice. Credentials & training A foundation in Thai and therapeutic work. Oregon Licensed Massage Therapist — License No. LMT-29905Diploma in Massage Therapy — Estelle Medical Academy (European Massage Therapy School), Skokie, IllinoisTraditional Thai bodywork training — Still Light CenterBLS Provider — American Heart Association; current through September 2028 For Portland-area practices Let’s talk about working together. If Butsaba’s approach sounds like a fit for your team, she would welcome a conversation about your practice and the care you offer. Contact ButsabaView Résumé Or email butsabad@gmail.com. For clients You can start with a goal, or simply a question. Thai massage may include rhythmic compression, guided movement, and assisted stretching. A quieter relaxation session or more focused therapeutic work may be a better fit on another day. Butsaba will talk through what you want and adapt the work to your comfort.
